header: The words above a team grid
lead: An eyebrow, a heading, a lead and a paragraph of rich text, with up to two links onward — and no portraits of its own.
bodytext:
Deliberately without people. It pairs with whichever team element follows, and keeping the copy and the faces in separate records is what lets a grid be swapped for a directory without anybody rewriting the introduction above it.

The band closes with half its usual air rather than a full one, because the element underneath brings its own top padding: two full bands between a heading and the faces it introduces read as two unrelated sections.
